title: Should Investors Buy Bloom Energy Stock Right Now in October?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc gives his first-ever call on Bloom Energy, a fuel-cell power company riding the AI data-center buildout. The business case: explosive demand for power to fuel data centers, plus longer-run drivers — vehicle electrification, home electrification, robots, and driverless cars — all requiring significant new power generation, and Bloom is well positioned. The numbers are strong: ~100% 2026 revenue growth and operating margins inflecting positive (11.2% TTM). But the 200%+ 2026 stock run is the problem: on forward P/E the stock actually looks cheap, yet his DCF fair value sits well below the market price, so he can't justify entering at current levels. He also flags risk: beta of 3.1, among the riskiest of everything he covers — the stock typically moves more than 3% for every 1% move in the S&P 500. Verdict: BE — HOLD, low conviction, and he cautions he could change the rating in the very near term if the dynamic situation shifts. This is a HOLD-without-ownership: he likes the business but wants a better valuation. Bull: hyperscaler power demand sustains the growth. Bear: expensive on DCF, 3x market volatility. No other tickers discussed. (He also briefly promotes his new book on his six-step investing framework.)
